skills.description: AUTO-INVOKED before any non-trivial task (2+ distinct steps). Analyzes the user's request, breaks it into ordered steps, assigns the best matching installed skills to each step, presents the plan, then executes each step in order using the assigned skills. If the user says "autonomous" or "don't ask", skip confirmation and execute immediately. Use this BEFORE doing anything else - planning comes first, execution comes second.
skills.name: auto-invoke

skills.description: Generate speech audio from text using the VibeVoice-1.5B TTS model. This skill should be used when the user asks to generate speech, synthesize voice, create audio from text, produce a podcast, or perform text-to-speech. Supports single and multi-speaker (up to 4) generation with voice cloning. Default voice is zh-Xinran_woman (Chinese female). Runs locally with CUDA, MPS (Apple Silicon), or CPU. Uses uv for environment management.
skills.name: vibevoice-tts
